_comment: Public functions in a web-app project shared beyond the owner (manifest webapp.access other than MYSELF) that are meant to be called by any signed-in visitor, so they carry no owner or teacher check. Each acts only on the caller's own identity (Session.getActiveUser()) or does nothing a visitor could misuse. Check web-app-public-function (tools/gas-lint/check.js) fails every other public function there that has no owner or teacher check. Add a function here only with the reason it is safe for anyone to call.

cas-ccps:student-dashboard.getStudentDashboardData: the caller's own assignments, from the session's identity
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.getMyCompetencies: the caller's own competencies, from the session's identity
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.getMyWarmUpHistory: the caller's own warm-ups, from the session's identity
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.getMyContext: the caller's own Student Context doc, from the session's identity
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.submitWarmUpAnswer: writes only the caller's own open warm-up row, under a lock (_dashWarmUpSave_)
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.submitWarmUpReply: writes only the caller's own open warm-up row, under a lock (_dashWarmUpSave_)
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.submitMyWork: submits only a Ledger row whose student is the caller (_dashSubmit_)
cas-ccps:student-dashboard.getSubmitReflection: the reflection questions for the caller's own row (_dashSubmitChecks_)

cas-ccps:teacher-dashboard.getMyStudentContext: the My Context page the dashboard serves a non-teacher: the caller's own Student Context doc

leader-hub:app.lhDiagPing: the ?diag=1 page's ping: the server time and the caller's own address
leader-hub:app.lhDiagReport: the ?diag=1 page's report: logs a capped summary to Executions, nothing else
